sections.name: an225-mriya.ldr
sections.description: Antonov An-225 Mriya at about 1:100, parked on 32 wheels with the nose visor raised and ramp lowered; X across, -Z forward, ground Y=0

sections.name: an225-keel.ldr
sections.description: Three-layer bonded keel (underside Y=-39) from the cargo opening to the belly upsweep, widened under the main-gear sponsons

sections.name: an225-fuselage.ldr
sections.description: Fuselage shell: bonded side walls reaching over the belly steps, blue ceiling cheatline, yellow pinstripe, windowed upper deck and curved-edge roof

sections.name: an225-sponsons.ldr
sections.description: Main-gear sponson fairings on the widened keel: outer walls, a 2-wide cap and outward curves meeting the fuselage wall

sections.name: an225-aft.ldr
sections.description: Upswept rear fuselage: six 4-stud belly steps (3030 deck over 13547 inverted curves) carried by the long wall courses, 24201 skirt and tapered tail cone

sections.name: an225-cockpit.ldr
sections.description: Upper-deck nose: 3937 visor hinge bases on the ceiling front, trans-black windscreen band with frames and forehead curve; s=8..9 is hinge clearance

sections.name: an225-hold.ldr
sections.description: Cargo hold floor: ramp hinge plates (44302a) at the lip, tiled floor, yellow threshold; containers stand on exposed keel studs

sections.name: an225-container-orange.ldr
sections.description: Microscale 40 ft container: three bonded brick courses and a tiled roof, standing on keel studs (underside Y=-63)

sections.name: an225-container-green.ldr
sections.description: Microscale 40 ft container: three bonded brick courses and a tiled roof, standing on keel studs (underside Y=-63)

sections.name: an225-main-gear.ldr
sections.description: Seven-axle main landing-gear bogie: 4600/4624/3641 pairs from the measured classic axle recipe on a staggered beam; local ground Y=0, beam top Y=-39

sections.name: axle-classic.ldr
sections.description: Fixed wheel-pin axle; separate rims and tyres; ground Y=0

sections.name: an225-nose-leg.ldr
sections.description: Nose landing-gear leg: one classic wheel pair and a two-plate strut; local ground Y=0, top Y=-39 meets the keel underside

sections.name: an225-wing.ldr
sections.description: High swept wing flush with the roof (underside Y=-239): studded 1:2 LE and 1:4 TE wedges, plate core, tiled top, trans-red/green tip lights

sections.name: an225-engine.ldr
sections.description: D-18T nacelle: dedicated 43121 jet engine hanging from a 2x6 pylon plate; mount anchor is the pylon top (wing underside), inlet -Z

sections.name: an225-tail.ldr
sections.description: H-tail: two-layer swept stabiliser on the rear roof and twin 54094 endplate fins on the stabiliser tips

sections.name: an225-details.ldr
sections.description: Buran carrier mounting pylons on the roof centre plates

sections.name: an225-visor.ldr
sections.description: Nose visor authored closed: inverted-curve chin, 2-wide slope rings, bonded plate shelves and 3938 hinge tops; placed rotated about the hinge line

sections.name: an225-ramp.ldr
sections.description: Forward loading ramp authored flat: 44301a hinge plates and plates, dark tiled deck with yellow edges; placed rotated down about the floor-lip hinge line
